name: Kana
source:
A married woman in her 30s, who is a friend of Yuka and Aya. A veteran staff who started back when their store just opened. She's slightly tanned with a plump body. 

Energetic, cheerful and friendly, but has a little mischievous side which you can't hate. She gets lots of customers who request for her. 

[Translated from [url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/relaxation_yuka_miyabi/]Official Site[/url]]
